name: Fire Golem Attack
description: Attack dealing [calc:pet_basic] ☀ Fire Damage to a single enemy.

name: Frost Golem Attack
description: Attack dealing [calc:pet_basic] ☀ Cold Damage to a single enemy.

name: Lightning Golem Attack
description: Attack dealing [calc:pet_basic] ☀ Lightning Damage to a single enemy.

name: Skeleton Attack
description: Attack dealing [calc:pet_basic] ☀ Physical Damage to a single enemy.

name: Spider Attack
description: Attack dealing [calc:spider_pet_basic] ☀ Chaos Damage to a single enemy.

name: Wolf Attack
description: Attack dealing [calc:pet_basic] ☀ Physical Damage to a single enemy.

name: Zombie Attack
description: Attack dealing [calc:pet_basic] ☀ Physical Damage to a single enemy.

name: Anti-Gravity Smash
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Linker stack.

Slam the ground in front of you, damaging enemies for [calc:anti_gravity_smash_initial] ☀ Physical Damage, and causing a black hole to arise from above and come crashing down. Enemies caught in the black hole rapidly take [calc:anti_gravity_smash] ☀ Physical Damage.

Generates a Combo Extender stack.

name: Asura
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Extender stack.

Surpass your limits to damage nearby enemies for [calc:asura] ☀ Physical Damage and yourself for [calc:asura_self] ☀ Physical Damage. Because of the massive effort, you Stun yourself for 1s on use.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Debilitating Blow
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Starter stack.

Assault the area in front of you, dealing [calc:debilitating_blow] ☀ Physical Damage to enemies in the area. Enemies hit are also slowed and have their Damage reduced for a short duration.

Generates a Combo Linker stack.

name: Eighth Gate
description:
Open your inner gate and deal [calc:eighth_gate] ☀ Physical Damage to yourself to immediately gain a Combo Extender stack.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Elemental Assault
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Starter stack.

Blast the area in front of you with the elements, dealing [calc:elemental_assault] ☀ Fire, ☀ Cold, and ☀ Lightning Damage. Upon use, your ☀ Physical Damage is converted to the elements for a short duration.

Generates a Combo Linker stack.

name: Flowing River Rush
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Linker stack.

Fire a cold blast which deals [calc:flowing_river_rush] ☀ Cold Damage to enemies hit, and upon expiry, teleport you to the cold blast. Additionally, the explosion will apply Stun to nearby enemies and form a pool of freezing water which deals [calc:flowing_river_rush] ☀ Cold Damage per second.

Generates a Combo Extender stack.

name: Fury
description:
This buff is needed for the rest of the Brawler Skills!

Empower yourself with wrath, giving your basic attacks the chance to generate a Combo Starter stack, which is used to use Brawler Skills.

name: Glacial Phoenix
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Extender stack.

Punch the ground in front of you, dealing [calc:glacial_phoenix] ☀ Cold Damage to enemies. Due to impact, the area remains shattered, causing ice shards to fall from the sky. Each ice shard deals [calc:glacial_phoenix] ☀ Cold Damage to any enemies caught in their path. The area's overall boundary size is fixed and unaffected by Area of Effect modifiers, but modifiers will increase the impact radius of individual ice shards.

name: Goading Strike
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Starter stack.

Deal [calc:goading_strike] ☀ Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and Taunt them. Enemies caught also gain increased Damage Taken, and have their Dodge Rating reduced.

Generates a Combo Linker stack.

name: Omnislash
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Extender stack.

Channel your Brawler strength into eight rapid and fearsome strikes, with each hit briefly applying Stun and dealing [calc:omnislash] ☀ Physical Damage.

name: Piercing Strike
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Starter stack.

Quickly strike the area in front of you, dealing [calc:piercing_strike] ☀ Physical Damage to enemies hit. Enemies hit also take increased ☀ Physical Damage for a short duration.

Generates a Combo Linker stack.

name: Raging Dragon
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Extender stack.

Strike in front with the force of a raging dragon, sending out a massive fire blast which deals [calc:raging_dragon] ☀ Fire Damage every 4 ticks in an area around it.

name: Rallying Sweep
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Linker stack.

Perform a sweeping kick around you, dealing [calc:rallying_sweep] ☀ Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Additionally, nearby allies gain increased Damage and Move Speed.

Generates a Combo Extender stack.

name: Spirit Offensive
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Linker stack.

Fire a piercing spirit orb which deals [calc:spirit_offensive] ☀ Chaos Damage to enemies hit. Once the orb reaches the end of its path, it returns to where it was fired, once again dealing [calc:spirit_offensive] ☀ Chaos Damage. Additionally, whenever the orb hits an enemy, it heals you for [calc:spirit_offensive_heal] Health.

Generates a Combo Extender stack.

name: Storming Tiger
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Extender stack.

Invoke the spirit of the tiger and very rapidly strike enemies around you, dealing [calc:storming_tiger] ☀ Lightning Damage.

name: Sweeping Blow
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Starter stack.

Sweep the area around you with a kick, stunning enemies and dealing [calc:sweeping_blow] ☀ Physical Damage. Enemies hit also get pulled to you.

Generates a Combo Linker stack.

name: Triple Blitz
description:
Requires and consumes a Combo Linker stack.

Rapidly strike enemies in front of you three times, with each hit dealing [calc:triple_blitz] ☀ Lightning Damage.

Generates a Combo Extender stack.

name: Zen
description: Enter a state of calm, increasing your Health Regen and giving your basic attacks the chance to recover [calc:energy_recover] Energy to you and nearby allies.

name: Dodge
description: Plays dodge sound.

name: Energy Recover
description: Recover [calc:energy_recover] Energy to you and nearby allies.

name: MS Regen
description: Restores your Magic Shield at a rapid rate over a short duration.

name: Passive Block
description: Plays passive block sound.

name: Taunt
description: Shout, making nearby enemies want to attack you. Generates [calc:taunt] threat.

name: Chronobreak
description:
Fracture time and space itself around you, causing random explosions to take place in the area. Each explosion deals [calc:chronobreak] ☀ Cold Damage to nearby enemies. The area's overall boundary size is fixed and unaffected by Area of Effect modifiers, but modifiers will increase the impact radius of individual explosions.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

Alpha, Beta, and Gamma stacks are consumed upon Skill use.

Depending on the combination of effects, this Skill is modified:
Only Alpha: Enemies take [calc:chronobreak_extra] ☀ Cold Damage instead.
Only Beta: Explosions Slow and briefly Stun enemies hit.
Alpha + Beta: Enemies hit have their Cold and Lightning Resistances reduced for 6s.

In addition to the above, Gamma: The number of explosions is doubled.

name: Cold Snap
description:
Crash an area in front of you with snow and ice, causing an implosion of ice clusters, dealing [calc:cold_snap] ☀ Cold Damage to enemies in an area. If under the effect of Zap's Conduction, the ice clusters will explode, spewing shrapnel in all directions with each shard dealing [calc:cold_snap_half] ☀ Cold Damage. Note that these shards are not considered projectiles.

Generates a Beta stack upon cast. You can have up to 3 Beta stacks.

name: Conduction
description:
Generate synergies with Zap and Cold Snap. Also provides synergies between ☀ Lightning Damage and ☀ Cold Damage. While Conduction is active, casts of Zap or Cold Snap will temporarily alter the effect of the other:

Zap casts will cause Cold Snap explosions to additionally fire shrapnel in all directions, with each shrapnel shard dealing half the damage of Cold Snap. The shrapnel is not considered as a projectile.

Cold Snap casts will cause Zap to leave behind a static field which detonates after 1s dealing the same damage again.

name: Corporeal Respite
description: Partially phase out of the current dimension and delay oncoming ☀ Physical Damage. While phased, you gain Physical Damage Reduction but ☀ Physical Damage towards you always applies Bleed. Additionally, you take extra damage from Bleed.

name: Fusion
description: Using the power of technology, slam together an Alpha and Beta stack to generate a Gamma stack. You can have up to 3 Gamma stacks.

name: Parallel Convergence
description:
Bring together two dimensions in an area, causing a rift. Enemies caught in the area are slowed.

Alpha, Beta, and Gamma stacks are consumed upon Skill use.

Depending on the combination of effects, this Skill is modified:
Only Alpha: Enemies in the area take [calc:parallel_convergence_lightning] ☀ Lightning Damage every second. This hit has a high chance of proccing Shock.
Only Beta: Applies Stun to enemies in the area for 1s, every 2s.
Alpha + Beta: Allies in the area heal for [calc:parallel_convergence] Health every second.

In addition to the above, Gamma: Increases the area of the rift by 33%.

name: Phase Dive
description:
Toss out an imbued snowball which explodes on contact. Modifiers to Projectile Speed apply to Phase Dive. Upon expiry, the snowball deals [calc:phase_dive] ☀ Cold Damage to enemies in an area.

Alpha, Beta, and Gamma stacks are consumed upon Skill use.

Depending on the combination of effects, this Skill is modified:
Only Alpha: The projectile pierces, and upon expiry, teleports you to its position. Enemies caught in the snowball's path take [calc:phase_dive] ☀ Cold Damage.
Only Beta: Upon expiry, stun and teleport nearby enemies to you. The explosion also instead deals [calc:phase_dive_beta] ☀ Cold Damage.
Alpha + Beta: In additional to dealing damage, also heal allies for [calc:phase_dive] Health and reduces the cooldown of all Skills by 0.5s.

In addition to the above, Gamma: Upon expiry, the impacted area is showered with ice pellets, causing enemies to take [calc:phase_dive_blizz] ☀ Cold Damage each second.

name: Pulsar Singularity Trap
description:
Throw out a trap that stays on the ground and activates when an enemy approaches. Upon activation, the trap explodes, dealing [calc:pulsar_singularity_trap] ☀ Lightning Damage in an area.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

Alpha, Beta, and Gamma stacks are consumed upon Skill use.

Depending on the combination of effects, this Skill is modified:
Only Alpha: The trap also deals [calc:pulsar_singularity_trap] ☀ Cold Damage.
Only Beta: The trap also applies Stun to enemies for 2s.
Alpha + Beta: After exploding, a large area is electrified, dealing [calc:pulsar_singularity_trap_half] ☀ Lightning Damage to enemies every second for 3s.

In addition to the above, Gamma: The trap pulls enemies hit towards it on explosion. Enemies hit also have their Lightning and Chaos Resistances lowered.

name: Time Dilation
description: Slow down time for everything but yourself, causing you to move quicker (relatively).

name: Timewinder
description:
Throw out a piercing ice shard that slows and deals [calc:timewinder] ☀ Cold Damage to enemies hit. Upon expiry, the ice shard converts into an electric bolt and quickly returns to the cast position, piercing and dealing [calc:timewinder] ☀ Lightning Damage to enemies hit.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

Alpha, Beta, and Gamma stacks are consumed upon Skill use.

Depending on the combination of effects, this Skill is modified:
Only Alpha: On hit, the ice shard also causes the enemy to take increased ☀ Lightning Damage for a short duration.
Only Beta: The ice shard continuously pulls nearby enemies towards it.
Alpha + Beta: The ice shard leaves a trail of snow, which periodically slows and deals [calc:timewinder_floor] ☀ Cold Damage.

In addition to the above, Gamma: Fire 2 additional projectiles.

name: Turbo
description: Extend yourself a bit past your limits to instantaneously generate an Alpha and Beta stack.

name: Zap
description:
Fire a small and quick projectile which chains once. Each hit deals [calc:zap] ☀ Lightning Damage. If under the effect of Cold Snap's Conduction, each hit will also leave behind a static zone which explodes after 1s, dealing [calc:zap] ☀ Lightning Damage to enemies in an area.

Generates an Alpha stack upon cast. You can have up to 3 Alpha stacks.

name: Blessed Aim
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Blessed Aim Aura on yourself. While active, nearby allies gain the Blessed Aim Effect, which increases Critical Hit and Accuracy.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

name: Blessed Hammer
description:
Throw out a spiritual hammer which spirals around you, gaining momentum as it travels. The hammer pierces enemies and deals [calc:blessed_hammer] ☀ Lightning Damage to enemies hit.

Retribution: Consume a Retribution stack to throw out 2 additional hammers around you.

name: Comeuppance
description:
Slam your weapon into the ground to send out a shockwave which deals [calc:comeuppance] ☀ Lightning Damage in a large area around you.

Retribution: Consume a Retribution stack to also Slow and Taunt enemies in the area.

name: Concentration
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Concentration Aura on yourself. While active, nearby allies gain the Concentration Effect, which increases Damage dealt.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

name: Defiance
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Defiance Aura on yourself. While active, nearby allies gain the Defiance Effect, which provides a bonuses to Armor and a small amount of Damage Reduction.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

name: Fanaticism
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Fanaticism Aura on yourself. While active, nearby allies gain the Fanaticism Effect, which increases Attack Speed, Cast Speed, Move Speed, and Roll Cooldown.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

name: Fist of Judgment
description:
Sacrifice your own Health, dealing [calc:fist_of_judgment_self] ☀ Fire and ☀ Lightning Damage to yourself to mark an area with your blood. After 2.25s, the marked area is slammed with the power of the Gods, knocking back and dealing [calc:fist_of_judgment] ☀ Fire and ☀ Lightning Damage in an area.

Retribution: Consume a Retribution stack to also heal allies in the marked area for [calc:fist_of_judgment] Health.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Holy Fire
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Holy Fire Aura on yourself. While active, nearby enemies take [calc:holy_fire] ☀ Fire Damage every 0.5s, and you take [calc:holy_fire_self] ☀ Fire Damage every 0.5s. This damage also scales off of your Max Health. If damage is dealt to yourself while below 25% Health, the Aura will remove itself.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Holy Immolation
description: Imbue your flames with Holy power. Holy Immolation sacrifices Burn Damage to give your Burn Ailment a chance to deal [calc:immolate] ☀ Fire Damage in an area around the enemy on the initial Burn proc.

name: Holy Shield Throw
description:
Throw out a spiritual shield which deals [calc:holy_shield_throw] ☀ Fire and ☀ Lightning Damage in an area upon contact. The damage is also influenced by your Passive Block Chance.

Retribution: Consume a Retribution stack to also apply Judgment on enemies hit, causing them to gain increased Damage Taken.

name: Holy Shock
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Holy Shock Aura on yourself. While active, nearby allies gain the Holy Shock Effect, which increases ☀ Lightning Damage and provides Physical to Lightning. Additionally, nearby enemies take [calc:holy_shock] ☀ Lightning Damage every 2s.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

name: Martyrdom
description:
Sacrifice [calc:martyrdom_self] Health as ☀ Physical Damage to heal nearby allies (excluding yourself) for [calc:martyrdom].

Retribution: Consume a Retribution stack to prevent Martyrdom from dealing damage to yourself.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Meditation
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Meditation Aura on yourself. While active, nearby allies gain the Meditation Effect, which substantially increases Mana and Energy Regeneration.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

name: Persecutory Thrust
description:
Thrust your blade forward, channeling a piercing, holy beam which deals [calc:persecutory_thrust] ☀ Fire and ☀ Lightning Damage to enemies in your way. While channeling the beam, also deal [calc:persecutory_thrust_self] ☀ Fire and ☀ Lightning Damage to yourself.

Retribution: Consume a Retribution stack to prevent the beam from dealing damage to yourself.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Prayer
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Prayer Aura on yourself. While active, nearby allies heal for [calc:prayer] Health and Magic Shield each second. They also gain the Prayer Effect, which provides a bonus to Healing Received.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time. You can also view the Prayer Effect in the Mine and Slash Library, available through the HUB.

name: Reckoner's Flail
description:
Throw out an ignited chain which chains and hits additional enemies. Each hit from the chain deals [calc:reckoners_flail] ☀ Fire Damage and pulls them to you.

Retribution: Consume a Retribution stack to also apply Stun to all enemies hit for 4s.

name: Redemption
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Redemption Aura on yourself. While active, nearby allies gain the Redemption Effect, which provides substantial Health and Magic Shield on Kill.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

name: Safeguard
description:
This buff is needed to gain Retribution stacks used in the other Crusader Skills!

Enhance yourself with the ability to defend your allies. Grants you Passive Block Chance, Health, and the chance to gain Retribution on successful blocks. You can have up to 5 Retribution stacks.

name: Salvation
description:
Harness the power of divinity, applying the Salvation Aura on yourself. While active, nearby allies gain the Salvation Effect, which increases Elemental Resistances.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

name: Immolate
description: On the initial Burn proc, deal [calc:immolate] ☀ Fire Damage in an area around the enemy.

name: Avalanche Vault
description: Leap forward and slam the ground, applying Stun for 1s and dealing [calc:avalanche_vault] ☀ Physical Damage and [calc:avalanche_vault] ☀ Cold Damage in an area. If the enemy is Snow-Tracked, each stack of Snow-Tracked is consumed to cause the enemy to take increased damage.

name: Banner of the Blizzard
description:
Place a banner on the ground which emits a constant wave of snow in an area around it. The banner grants nearby allies increased Resource Regen and Leech and a chance for their basic attacks to apply Stun for 2s. Enemies standing in the area are Slowed.

You can only have ONE Banner active at a time.

name: Banner of the Frozen Guard
description:
Place a banner on the ground which pulses every 2s, briefly slowing and damaging nearby enemies for [calc:banner_of_the_frozen_guard] ☀ Cold Damage. If the enemy is Snow-Tracked, they instead take [calc:banner_of_the_frozen_guard_tracked] ☀ Cold Damage, which scales with Armor. The banner also grants nearby allies Armor and Dodge gained as Armor.

You can only have ONE Banner active at a time.

name: Banner of the Hunt
description:
Place a banner on the ground which improves a hunter's focus and marks nearby enemies. Nearby allies gain increased Dodge Rating, Attack Speed, and Move Speed. Every 1.5s, nearby enemies are marked, becoming Snow-Tracked.

You can only have ONE Banner active at a time.

name: Banner of the Piercing Gale
description:
Place a banner on the ground which emits a frigid wave of cold. Enemies caught in the cold near the banner have their Armor and ☀ Cold Resistance reduced.

You can only have ONE Banner active at a time.

name: Chilled Reflexes
description: Enhance yourself a cooling chill, greatly improving your Dodge Rating for a short time. While active, successfully dodging an attacker causes them to become Snow-Tracked.

name: Frostbite Thrust
description: Rapidly thrust your weapon forward 3 times, hitting all enemies in front of you for [calc:frostbite_thrust] ☀ Cold Damage each time. If the enemy is Snow-Tracked, instead deal [calc:frostbite_thrust_tracked] ☀ Cold Damage. If you're under the effects of Whiteout Sovereign, you also restore [calc:frostbite_thrust_energy_restore] Energy on each thrust.

name: Glacial Condemnation
description: Throw a freezing spear of ice, encasing the first enemy hit in ice, dealing [calc:glacial_condemnation] ☀ Cold Damage. The enemy becomes Snow-Tracked and is brought to the ground, unable to move for a short period of time.

name: Glacial Dash
description:
Quickly surge forward in a blast of frost, briefly slowing and dealing [calc:glacial_dash] ☀ Cold Damage to enemies in the way. While surging, you also envelop yourself in ice, briefly reducing damage taken from Snow-Tracked enemies. Enemies hit also become super Snow-Tracked, gaining 3 stacks of Snow-Tracked.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Hoarfrost Armor
description: Embrace the cold, surrounding yourself with sheets of ice to improve your Armor and Move Speed. While active, your basic attacks against Stunned enemies have a chance to trigger Glacial Mend, healing yourself for [calc:hoarfrost_armor_heal] Health.

name: Ice-Tipped Blade
description:
Overlay your weapon with a sharp coating of ice, causing your attacks to deal ☀ Cold Damage. While active, your basic attacks trigger Cryogenic Rupture on Snow-Tracked enemies, consuming the Snow-Tracked effect. When this happens, the enemy struck bursts, taking [calc:ice_tipped_spear_stun] ☀ Cold Damage, and becoming Stunned for 2s. Due to the burst, they also fire a round of ice shards that splay in the nearby area, with each shard dealing [calc:ice_tipped_spear_stun] ☀ Cold Damage. Additionally, if the coating is on a spear, deal extra damage.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Rime Reaver
description:
Spin around rapidly to whip up a glacial storm, firing piercing ice pellets in all directions. Nearby enemies take [calc:rime_reaver_half] ☀ Cold Damage and the pellets deal [calc:rime_reaver] ☀ Cold Damage to all enemies in their path. Against Snow-Tracked enemies, the pellets implode, firing another round of pellets in all directions, dealing [calc:rime_reaver_half] ☀ Cold Damage. Enemies hit by Rime Reaver are briefly slowed.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Tailwind Sweep
description: Sweep the ground around you, knocking enemies back and dealing [calc:tailwind_sweep] ☀ Physical Damage and [calc:tailwind_sweep] ☀ Cold Damage. For each enemy hit, gain a Tailwind stack (max 5) which grants bonus Move Speed for a short period of time. Enemies hit also become Snow-Tracked.

name: Vortex Skewer
description:
Throw a spiraling frozen spear, piercing and pulling enemies in its path. At the end of its path it explodes. Upon exploding, enemies impaled by the spear take [calc:vortex_skewer] ☀ Cold Damage and become briefly Slowed and Snow-Tracked.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Whiteout Sovereign
description:
Leap forward and slam the ground with force, dealing [calc:whiteout_sovereign] ☀ Cold Damage and summoning a raging hailstorm. Enemies hit by the initial slam become Snow-Tracked.

While active, the storm rains down hail chunks that each deal [calc:whiteout_sovereign_icicle] ☀ Cold Damage. The storm's overall boundary size is fixed and unaffected by Area of Effect modifiers, but modifiers will increase the impact radius of individual hail chunks.

Upon landing from the leap, you gain ☀ Cold Penetration for 8s. During this window, your basic attacks have a chance to summon additional hailstorms when hitting Snow-Tracked enemies.

name: Winter's Grasp
description:
Chill and take in the air around you, pulling enemies in and dealing [calc:winters_grasp] ☀ Cold Damage to them. Snow-Tracked enemies caught have the effect consumed, are Stunned for 4s, and deal much less damage for 10s.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Glacial Mend
description: Heal yourself for [calc:hoarfrost_armor_heal] Health.

name: Cryogenic Rupture
description:
On Snow-Tracked enemies, deal [calc:ice_tipped_spear_stun] ☀ Cold Damage and apply Stun for 2s. The enemy also bursts, splaying ice shards in the area, with each shard dealing [calc:ice_tipped_spear_stun] ☀ Cold Damage. This consumes the Snow-Tracked effect on the target.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Whiteout Sovereign (Storm)
description: Hail falls from the sky, with each hail chunk dealing [calc:whiteout_sovereign_icicle] ☀ Cold Damage. The storm's overall boundary size is fixed and unaffected by Area of Effect modifiers, but modifiers will increase the impact radius of individual hail chunks.

name: Armageddon
description:
Generates a stack of Overheat on cast.

Hail down fiery explosions on your enemies, where each explosion deals [calc:armageddon] ☀ Fire Damage in an area. The armageddon's overall boundary size is fixed and unaffected by Area of Effect modifiers, but modifiers will increase the impact radius of individual explosions.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Blizzard
description:
Removes a stack of Overheat on cast. If Overheat was removed, recover [calc:mage_restore] Mana.

Create a cloud that sends out freezing waves, slowing and damaging enemies for [calc:blizzard] ☀ Cold Damage.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Blood Boil
description: Release an anger-inducing wave, dealing [calc:blood_boil] ☀ Fire Damage and [calc:blood_boil] ☀ Cold Damage to nearby enemies. Enemies in the vicinity are also taunted.

name: Chilling Field
description:
Removes a stack of Overheat on cast. If Overheat was removed, recover [calc:mage_restore] Mana.

Spawn a cloud of frost, slowing and damaging enemies for [calc:chilling_field] ☀ Cold Damage every second.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Fire Nova
description: Blast the nearby area in flames, dealing [calc:fire_nova] ☀ Fire Damage to enemies.

name: Fire Wall
description:
Generates a stack of Overheat on cast.

Spew forth a wall of fire, preventing enemies from getting to close to you. Enemies that touch the wall are knocked back and dealt [calc:fire_wall] ☀ Fire Damage.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Fire Ball
description:
Generates a stack of Overheat on cast.

Throw out a ball of fire, dealing [calc:fireball] ☀ Fire Damage.

name: Mage Armor
description: Surround yourself in magic, granting you supernatural powers. While Mage Armor is active, your Burst-tagged Skills have a chance to cast Elemental Burst, which deals [calc:shatter] ☀ Cold and ☀ Fire Damage in an area around the enemy.

name: Frost Nova
description:
Removes a stack of Overheat on cast. If Overheat was removed, recover [calc:mage_restore] Mana.

Explode with frost around you, applying Bone Chill and dealing [calc:frost_nova] ☀ Cold Damage to nearby enemies. Nearby allies are soothed, and heal [calc:frost_nova_heal] Health per second for 5s.

name: Ice Shard
description:
Removes a stack of Overheat on cast. If Overheat was removed, recover [calc:mage_restore] Mana.

Throw out a piercing shard of ice, slowing and dealing [calc:iceball] ☀ Cold Damage to enemies hit.

name: Frozen Orb
description:
Removes a stack of Overheat on cast. If Overheat was removed, recover [calc:mage_restore] Mana.

Throw an ice orb that briefly slows and deals [calc:iceball_half] ☀ Cold Damage to nearby enemies as it travels. While travelling, passing through enemies causes them the orb to vibrate, spewing ice shards in all directions. Each shard deals [calc:iceball_half] ☀ Cold Damage. Upon reaching its destination, the orb explodes, slowing and dealing [calc:iceball_explosion] ☀ Cold Damage in an area.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Heart of Ice
description: Applies Magic Shield to nearby allies. Also applies Soothe which restores your Magic Shield at a rapid rate over a short duration.

name: Ice Comet
description:
Removes a stack of Overheat on cast. If Overheat was removed, recover [calc:mage_restore] Mana.

Summon a comet that falls from the sky, which knocks back and deals [calc:ice_comet] ☀ Cold Damage upon impact.

Can trigger Elemental Burst.

name: Inferno
description: Rapidly splay flames from your fingertips, dealing [calc:inferno] ☀ Fire Damage to enemies hit. The flames also pierce the enemy.

name: Mage Circle
description: Summon a Magic Circle. Standing in it increases your Skill and Critical Damage.

name: Magma Orb
description:
Generates a stack of Overheat on cast.

Summon a flaming orb which pulsates, engulfing the area in flames, dealing [calc:magma_orb] ☀ Fire Damage to nearby enemies every second until exploding, dealing [calc:magma_orb_explosion] ☀ Fire Damage in a larger area. Hits also apply Scorched for 3s.

Quickly toss an axe which deals [calc:boomerang] ☀ Physical Damage. The axe also chains twice upon striking a target.

Quickly charge forward, ramming yourself into the first enemy hit, knocking back enemies and dealing [calc:charge] ☀ Physical Damage in a small area.

Fighter Stance: Charge forward 50% faster.

name: Defender Stance
description:
Enter Defender Stance, which increases your defense at the cost of speed. Also periodically taunts nearby enemies. Defender Stance also augments Fighter Skills to be more defensive.

Some Fighter Skills may be less effective if no Stance is active.

name: Stance
description:
Toggle between Fighter Stance and Defender Stance.

Fighter Stance increases your Attack Speed and Move Speed at the cost of defenses, and Defender Stance taunts nearby enemies and increases your Knockback Resistance at the cost of speed.

Stances also augments Fighter Skills depending on which Stance you're currently in.

Fighter Skills are less effective if no Stance is active.

name: Flame Strike
description:
Swing your blade, striking enemies in front of you for [calc:flame_strike] ☀ Fire Damage.

Fighter Stance: Send out a Fireball upon swinging which deals [calc:flame_strike_fighter] ☀ Fire Damage in an area.

Defender Stance: Apply Scorched for 8s.

name: Wind Slasher
description:
Quickly slice the air, sending out ripples of wind, dealing [calc:gale_wind_fighter] ☀ Physical Damage and knocking enemies back. Additional levels in Wind Slasher cause you to send out more blasts of wind per swing.

Hits against Thorned enemies Slow them.

Fighter Stance: Each ripple pierces enemies and traverses 33% faster.

Defender Stance: Briefly apply Stun to the enemy and instead, deal [calc:gale_wind] ☀ Physical Damage.

name: Gong Strike
description:
Bash enemies around you, dealing [calc:gong_strike_plain] ☀ Physical Damage in front of you. 

Fighter Stance: Instead, deal [calc:gong_strike_fighter] ☀ Physical Damage in a larger area in front of you.

Defender Stance: Instead, deal [calc:gong_strike] ☀ Physical Damage and briefly apply Stun to enemies.

name: Incinerating Weapon Toss
description:
Toss out a weapon imbued with fire, rapidly dealing [calc:weapon_toss] ☀ Fire Damage to enemies it passes through. Upon expiry, the weapon combusts, dealing [calc:weapon_toss_explode] ☀ Fire Damage and knocking back enemies in an area. Modifiers to Projectile Speed apply to Incinerating Weapon Toss.

Fighter Stance: Quickly warp to your weapon once it expires.

Defender Stance: Enemies caught in the explosion are sent to you.

name: Meditate
description: Stand in silence and recover yourself, healing for [calc:meditate] Health per activation. While channeling, you are stunned.

name: Protection
description: Steady your awareness and improve the Armor and Elemental Resistances of nearby allies.

description:

description:

description:
Slash all nearby enemies 3 times, dealing [calc:shred] ☀ Physical Damage and applying a stack of Shred with each hit.

Fighter Stance: Deal [calc:shred_fighter] ☀ Physical Damage instead.

Defender Stance: Apply an additional stack of Shred with each hit.

name: Tidal Strike
description:
Strike enemies in front of you, dealing [calc:tidal_strike] ☀ Cold Damage.

Fighter Stance: Hits send out a small AOE, dealing [calc:tidal_strike_fighter] ☀ Cold Damage.

Defender Stance: Apply Stun to enemies.

name: Undying Will

You can view the effects of Berserk in the Mine and Slash Library, available through the HUB.

name: Whirlwind
description:

Fighter Stance: Deal damage in an increased area.

name: Cursed Charged Bomb
description: Fire out an orb that explodes upon impact, dealing [calc:cursed_lightning_nova] ☀ Lightning Damage to nearby enemies. Also applies a stack of Static to nearby allies upon cast.

Summon a Cursed Meteor that falls from the sky, knocking back and dealing [calc:cursed_meteor] ☀ Fire Damage in an area.

description: Throw out 3 balls of music, Charming and dealing [calc:cursed_power_chord] ☀ Physical Damage. Charmed enemies have their defenses reduced. The balls have a chance to Stun.

name: Cursed Quake
description: Smash the enemies in front of you, dealing [calc:cursed_quake] ☀ Physical Damage and sending out 6 subsequent explosions which also deal damage and knocks back enemies. Each explosion also applies a stack of Shred on hit.

description: Fire 3 magically-imbued arrows that chain three times, dealing [calc:cursed_ricochet_shot] ☀ Physical Damage to struck enemies.

Upon expiry, the ice shards convert into electric bolts and quickly return to the cast position, piercing and dealing [calc:cursed_timewinder] ☀ Lightning Damage to enemies hit. On hit, the ice shard also causes the enemy to take increased ☀ Lightning Damage for a short duration.

description: Basic Attack dealing [calc:cursed_pet_basic] ☀ Physical Damage to single enemy.

description: Granted from Kinesis Runeword.

description: Hail arrows down upon your foes in a small area, with each arrow dealing [calc:arrow_storm] ☀ Physical Damage. The storm's overall boundary size is fixed and unaffected by Area of Effect modifiers, but modifiers will increase the impact radius of individual arrows.

Enemies hit are slowed and are dealt [calc:frost_trap] ☀ Cold Damage. The first pulse also applies Encased, which triggers on basic attack, applying Stun and dealing [calc:encased] ☀ Cold Damage in an area.

description: Drink a potion, healing you for [calc:hunter_pot_heal] Health.

description: Fire a magic-imbued arrow that deals [calc:hunters_mark] ☀ Physical Damage and causes struck enemies to be marked, Marked enemies take extra damage and are targeted by your Summons.

description: Spew out knives around you, with each knife dealing [calc:fan_of_knives] ☀ Physical Damage to enemies. Additional levels in Fan of Knives cause you to spew more knives.

description: Throw a magically imbued splash potion which explodes upon impact, dealing [calc:flame_splash_potion] ☀ Fire Damage in a small area. Struck enemies also receive the Cinder effect, causing Attack Hits against them to have a chance to deal [calc:cinder] ☀ Fire Damage in an area.

name: Piercing Dagger Throw
description:

description: Fire a magically-imbued arrow that chains three times, dealing [calc:ricochet_shot] ☀ Physical Damage to struck enemies.

name: Snipe
description: Imbue your next shot with immense power, charging then dealing [calc:snipe] ☀ Physical Damage to your target with high chance of critically striking. Enemies hit are knocked back. Snipe deals [calc:snipe_double] ☀ Physical Damage while Invisible. Snipe deals more damage to enemies near full Health.

name: Venom Splash Potion
description: Throw a magically imbued splash potion which explodes upon impact, dealing [calc:venom_splash_potion] ☀ Chaos Damage in a small area. Struck enemies also receive the Venom effect, causing Attack Hits against them to have a chance to deal [calc:venom] ☀ Chaos Damage.

description: Deal [calc:cinder] ☀ Fire Damage in a small area.

name: Venom
description: Deal [calc:venom] ☀ Chaos Damage to the enemy.

name: Abyssal Aura
description:
Forsake your own salvation, applying the Abyssal Aura on yourself and nearby allies. While active, only you take [calc:abyssal_aura_self] ☀ Chaos Damage every 0.5s, to provide to yourself and allies a portion of Health gained as Added Chaos Damage and increase to Chaos Damage. If damage is dealt to yourself while below 25% Health, the Aura will remove itself.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Banishing Blade
description: Empower Melee Skills and Melee Basic Attack hits to have a chance of dealing [calc:soul_wound] ☀ Physical Damage and applying 1 stack of Soul Wound to enemies hit. Hitting an enemy with 3 stacks of Soul Wound consumes the stacks, causing it to take [calc:soul_wound_big] ☀ Physical Damage and receive a debuff that increases damage taken from Weapon Skills for 20s.

Plague: Additionally gain Dexterity and Dexterity gained as Ailment Damage.

Sanguine: Additionally Gain Bleed Chance and Bleed Damage gained as Skill Damage.

Abyssal: Additionally converts ☀ Physical Damage into ☀ Chaos Damage and elemental resistances.

name: Blood Harvest
description:
Use your own life force, dealing [calc:blood_harvest_self] ☀ Physical Damage to yourself to give yourself and nearby allies Blood Harvest for 30s. While active, Blood Harvest restores [calc:blood_harvest] Blood every 1s.

Requires the Blood Mage Gamechanger Talent to receive benefits from this Skill.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Cataclysm

name: Curse of Damnation
description:

name: Dark Pact
description:
Channel dark energy, dealing [calc:dark_pact] ☀ Chaos Damage to enemies around you, and causing you to take [calc:dark_pact_self] ☀ Chaos Damage.

Consume 3 Sacrifice Stacks: Dark Pact deals [calc:dark_pact_sacrifice] ☀ Chaos Damage instead.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Drain

name: Plague Aura
description:
Become a plague bearer, applying the Plague Aura to nearby enemies. While active, you have a chance to gain a Sacrifice Stack when hit (including self-damage), and take [calc:plague_aura_self] ☀ Physical Damage every 0.5s. Nearby enemies gain increased chance to receive ailments. If damage is dealt to yourself while below 25% Health, the Aura will remove itself.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

description:
Enter Reaper Form for 10s, which increases Scythe Damage, gives you a chance to gain a Sacrifice Stack when hit (including self-damage), and Movement Speed. Basic attacks with Scythes have a chance to refresh Reaper Form's duration.

Depending on your active Aura, this Skill is modified:

Plague: Additionally increases your Ailment Damage.

Sanguine: Additionally increases Bleed Damage and grants Magic Hits Health Leech.

Abyssal: Also increases Chaos Damage and reduces Resource Costs.

name: Sanguine Aura
description:
Fully embrace hemomancy, applying the Sanguine Aura on yourself. While active, only you take [calc:sanguine_aura_self] ☀ Physical Damage every 0.5s, to provide to yourself and allies a portion of Health as Added Physical Damage and Bleed Damage gained as Skill Damage. If damage is dealt to yourself while below 25% Health, the Aura will remove itself.

You can only have ONE Aura active at a time.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Shadow Step
description: Swiftly move in the direction you're looking at. Create a cloud of shadows upon landing, applying Blind and Slow to surrounding enemies.

name: Siphon
description:
Send a homing shadow sphere towards an enemy, dealing [calc:soul_siphon] ☀ Chaos Damage. Additionally, damage from this skill ALWAYS applies Drain (regardless of what Aura you have active), which deals [calc:drain] ☀ Chaos Damage every 1s for 5s.

Consume 3 Sacrifice Stacks: the sphere explodes on impact, damaging enemies in an area.

Depending on your active Aura, this Skill is modified. Sacrifice Stack effects are in green:

Plague: The sphere pierces through enemies and and deals Physical Damage instead. The sphere shatters on impact or after a short delay, dealing [calc:soul_siphon_cloud] ☀ Physical Damage every 0.5s for 3s in an area.

Sanguine: Fire a blood orb that chains up to 2 times, dealing [calc:soul_siphon_blood] Physical Damage instead. Instead of chaining, the blood orb moves slowly, firing homing orbs every 0.5s that chain up to 2 times.

Abyssal: Fire a slow-moving abyssal vortex that deals [calc:soul_siphon] ☀ Chaos Damage in an area every 0.25s. Send out an abyssal orb that explodes, firing 5 abyssal vortexes in a nova.

name: Soul Wound
description: Applying Soul Wound deals [calc:soul_wound] ☀ Physical Damage. When an enemy has 3 stacks, they get consumed to deal [calc:soul_wound_big] ☀ Physical Damage and increase the damage they take from Weapon Skills for 20s.

name: Summon Wraith's Grave

Raise a tombstone from the ground that lasts 10s. The tombstone summons a Wraith every 1s that tracks enemies. Wraiths explode on contact, dealing [calc:summon_wraith] ☀ Chaos Damage in an area.

Plague: Upon exploding, Wraiths leave a lingering flame that deals [calc:summon_wraith_cloud] ☀ Fire Damage every 0.5s for 3s.

description: Strike enemies with chaining lightning that deals [calc:chain_lightning] ☀ Lightning Damage. The lightning chains three times. Apply a stack of Static to nearby allies upon cast.

name: Chain Lightning Totem
description: Summons a totem that periodically fires Chain Lightning to nearby enemies, dealing [calc:chain_lightning_totem] ☀ Lightning Damage to enemies hit. Levels in Chain Lightning increase the damage of Chain Lightning Totem.

name: Chaos Totem
description: Summons a totem that randomly barrages nearby enemies with void energy from above, dealing [calc:chaos_totem] ☀ Chaos Damage in a small area upon impact. For enemies in range, there is a 50% chance every 0.5s that void energy strikes them from above.

name: Cyclone
description:
Send out a torrential wind which pulls in enemies, dealing [calc:cyclone] ☀ Physical Damage in rapid succession to enemies caught in the tornado. At the end of its path, the tornado remains stationary for 2s, continuing to pull in and deal damage to enemies.

Hits against Thorned enemies deals [calc:cyclone_thorned] ☀ Physical Damage instead.

name: Entangling Seed
description:
Throw out a seed that explodes and petrifies enemies. Also applies 3 stacks of Thorns.

Thorned enemies consume a stack of Thorns every time they are basic attacked to deal [calc:thorn_consume] ☀ Physical Damage.

name: Flamethrower Totem
description: Summons a totem that rapidly spews out flames to the nearest enemy, dealing [calc:flamethrower_totem] ☀ Fire Damage to enemies hit. The flames also pierce the enemy.

name: Frost Totem
description: Summon a frost totem that applies Bone Chill and deals [calc:flower_flower] ☀ Cold Damage in an area every second.

name: Galvanic Blade
description: Imbue your weapon with galvanic energy, converting your ☀ Physical Damage into ☀ Lightning Damage. Also grants a chance for ☀ Lightning Damage to cast Discharge, which sends out static ripples from struck enemies, dealing [calc:galvanic_blade] ☀ Lightning Damage in a small area. Discharge can only trigger once off cooldown.

name: Garden of Thorns
description:
Barrage an area with barbs 5 times, with each barb applying Thorns and dealing [calc:thorn_consume] ☀ Physical Damage in an area. Also gives you Inner Calm which restores [calc:inner_calm] Mana/s.

Thorned enemies consume a stack of Thorns every time they are basic attacked to deal [calc:thorn_consume] ☀ Physical Damage.

name: Charged Bomb
description: Fire out an orb that explodes upon impact, dealing [calc:lightning_nova] ☀ Lightning Damage to nearby enemies. Also applies a stack of Static to nearby allies upon cast.

name: Lightning Spear
description: Throw out an electric spear, dealing [calc:lightning_spear] ☀ Lightning Damage.

name: Lightning Totem
description: Summon a lightning totem that deals [calc:lightning_totem] ☀ Lightning Damage in an area every second. Apply a stack of Static to nearby allies upon cast.

name: Magma Totem
description: Summon a flaming totem that deals [calc:magma_flower] ☀ Fire Damage to the nearest enemy in an area every 0.5s. Also applies Scorched for 3s.

name: Nature's Balm
description: Applies a stack of Rejuvenation to nearby allies which heals for [calc:rejuvenation] every second. Each stack of Rejuvenation further increases the heal from each stack. Also increases Thorns damage.

name: Power Surge
description: Imbue yourself with static, increasing your Cast Speed and Critical Damage.

name: Rejuvenating Totem
description: Summon a totem which restores [calc:totem_heal] Health to allies around it every second.

name: Lightning Warp
description: Quickly teleport yourself in the direction you're looking at.

name: Thorn Bush
description:
Summon a prickly bush that deals [calc:thorn_bush] ☀ Physical Damage in an area each second and applies Thorns.

Thorned enemies consume a stack of Thorns every time they are basic attacked to deal [calc:thorn_consume] ☀ Physical Damage.

5 Soul Stacks: Apply an additional stack of Thorns.

name: Discharge
description: Send out static ripples from struck enemies, dealing [calc:galvanic_blade] ☀ Lightning Damage in a small area. Discharge can only trigger once off cooldown.

name: Rejuvenation
description: Gives buff that heals nearby allies for [calc:rejuvenation] every second.

name: Summon Spider
description:
Summon a fast moving spider to fight for you.

These Spiders don't count toward the Maximum Summons limit.

name: Black Hole
description:
Summon a dark sphere that attracts nearby enemies to it, dealing [calc:black_hole] ☀ Chaos Damage when it expires.

5 Soul Stacks: +100% Increased Area.

name: Chilling Touch
description:
Strike and Slow enemies in front for [calc:chilling_touch] ☀ Cold Damage, and command your summons to attack them. Additionally apply a stack of the Splinter effect (max 3) to struck enemies, allowing your summons to proc Splinter on hit. Each stack of the Splinter effect increases the proc chance.

Generates a Soul stack.

name: Curse of Agony
description:
Curse enemies with Curse of Agony and deal [calc:curse] ☀ Chaos Damage.

Generates a Soul stack.

name: Curse of Despair
description:
Curse enemies with Curse of Despair and deal [calc:curse] ☀ Chaos Damage.

Generates a Soul stack.

name: Curse of Weakness
description:
Curse enemies with Curse of Weakness and deal [calc:curse] ☀ Chaos Damage.

Generates a Soul stack.

name: Wyvern's Touch
description: Feel the chilling touch of a wyvern and channel it to yourself and nearby allies, boosting summon duration and damage over time.

name: Explode Minions
description:
Explodes all your nearby minions for [calc:explode_minion] ☀ Fire Damage. Damage also knocks back enemies. This damage also scales off of the summon's Health!

5 Soul Stacks: Deal an additional [calc:explode_minion] ☀ Chaos Damage.

name: Forbidden Rite
description:
Perform a forbidden rite, damaging yourself for [calc:forbidden_rite_self] ☀ Chaos Damage to fire a homing chaotic ball of devastation. The ball deals [calc:forbidden_rite] ☀ Chaos Damage, which scales with Health and Magic Shield.

Generates a Soul stack.

Increases to Damage and Critical Hits don't apply to Damage caused to self. You can still die from self-damage!

name: Blade of Desecrated Hallows
description: Imbue your weapon with deathly cold energy, converting your ☀ Physical Damage into ☀ Cold Damage. Blade of Desecrated Hallows also increases your ☀ Cold Penetration.

name: Acid Blast
description:
Blast out homing balls of poison, dealing [calc:poisonball] ☀ Chaos Damage.

Generates a Soul stack.

name: Acid Cloud
description:
Erupt with poisonous gas, dealing [calc:poison_cloud] ☀ Chaos Damage to nearby enemies. Enemies also receive Soul Rupture for 10s, reducing their Chaos Resistance.

5 Soul Stacks: Deals double damage.

name: Putrid Breath
description:
Infuse poison into your breath and exhale, layering the area in front of you with slow-moving clouds of poison. Each cloud deals [calc:putrid_breath] ☀ Chaos Damage to enemies as it passes through them.

5 Soul Stacks: Also slows enemies.

name: Return Summons
description: Regroup your summons and heal them for [calc:healing_aura] Health.

name: Revenant Slam
description:
Slam the ground in front of you, dealing [calc:revenant_slam] ☀ Cold Damage and creating a pool of desecrated ground. Ice chunks fly from the desecrated ground, dealing [calc:revenant_slam_rock] ☀ Cold Damage to enemies hit. Enemies killed by Revenant Slam also have their life force absorbed by the desecrated ground, recovering Health and Magic Shield to you. The pool's overall boundary size is fixed and unaffected by Area of Effect modifiers, but modifiers will increase the impact radius of individual rocks.

5 Soul Stacks: Deal ☀ Chaos Damage instead of ☀ Cold Damage. The ☀ Cold Damage knocks back enemies.

name: Summon Skeletons
description:
Summon 3 ranged Skeletons at once to fight for you.

These Skeletons don't count toward the Maximum Summons limit.

name: Summon Wisp
description:
Summon an ethereal Wisp which follows the nearest target and slowly eats away at their life force, dealing [calc:wisp] ☀ Physical and ☀ Cold Damage every 0.5s.

5 Soul Stacks: Summon an additional Wisp.

These Wisps don't count toward the Maximum Summons limit.

name: Summon Zombie
description: Summon a Zombie to aid you in combat.

name: Splinter
description: Enemies struck by your summons have a chance to cast Splinter, dealing [calc:splinter] ☀ Physical Damage in an area around them. Splinter can only trigger once off cooldown.

name: Target
description: Causes enemies hit by this Skill to become target by your summons.
